scope: synthetic analytic controls for dependence-aware exchange analysis
state_permutation: walker-0 and walker-1 swap endpoint labels on alternating frames; each frame still contains both states exactly once

correlated_gaussian_control.stationary_initialization: same innovation equation without the AR combination at t=0
correlated_gaussian_control.correlation_note: The common eta component yields a predeclared same-frame cross-walker residual correlation of 0.5; no scheduler or physical exchange is simulated.

resampling.block_tail_policy: all frames retained; 4096 is divisible by 32; any partial block rejects
resampling.draw_policy: sample nonoverlapping time blocks with replacement separately within each run; retain both walkers, sampled states, and all raw/outside energies from each selected frame; preserve each run's 4096-frame contribution
resampling.independent_runs_policy: sample 12 complete independently seeded runs with replacement; retain each selected run's full correlated history; do not add block or iid variance
resampling.failed_draw_policy: preserve draw number, selected raw sample IDs and failure reason; any failed, disconnected, or nonfinite draw withholds sampling covariance

predeclared_qualification_criteria.known_answer_each_estimator: absolute point-estimate error <= 0.1 kJ/mol and <= 3 bootstrap standard errors from +1.5 kJ/mol; reverse weights must return the negated value and same standard error
predeclared_qualification_criteria.zero_restraint_answer: independent analytic Gaussian integration returns zero within 1e-12 kJ/mol; this is not a molecular result
predeclared_qualification_criteria.identical_input_estimator_agreement: absolute PyMBAR versus pinned UWHAM point-estimate difference <= 1e-6 kJ/mol
predeclared_qualification_criteria.bootstrap_covariance_vs_independent_run_: for the B-minus-A contrast, ratio of 64-draw resampled variance to sample variance of the 12 independent run point estimates divided by 12 must lie in [0.5, 2.0]; a zero/nonfinite denominator or any failed draw is a hold
predeclared_qualification_criteria.no_tuning: seeds, equations, block length, replicate count, estimator agreement limit, and covariance interval remain fixed after the first control result

interpretation: Synthetic analytic evidence only. It does not measure scheduler mixing, conformational convergence, equilibrium sampling, molecular binding, or G08 acceptance.
